name: MMMU
intro: MMMU是一个评估多模态模型在需要大学水平知识和推理任务上的基准，包含来自六个学科的11,550个问题和多样化图像类型。该基准设计用于测试模型的高级感知与领域知识推理能力。
org: IN.AI Research, University of Waterloo, The Ohio State University, Carnegie Mellon University, Unive
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 大学级知识, 多模态推理, 领域专家能力
eval_feature_en: College-level knowledge, multimodal reasoning, expert capability
intro_en: MMMU is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal models on tasks requiring university-level knowledge and reasoning. It includes 11,550 questions from six disciplines and diverse image types. The benchmark is designed to test models' advanced perception and domain knowledge reasoning abilities.

drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2311.16502 Sections 3.1-4. The team first selected six disciplines, 30 subjects, and 183 subfields where visual inputs are common, then recruited over 50 specialist university students to collect or author about 13K licensed multimodal questions from textbooks, lecture materials, and online sources while avoiding immediately available answers. Lexical overlap and source-URL similarity identify duplicate candidates for author adjudication; co-authors then correct format and typos, assign four difficulty levels, and remove roughly 10% very-easy items. The final 11,550 questions span 30 image types and split 150 development, 900 validation, and 10,500 test; zero-shot responses are rule-parsed for micro-averaged accuracy.
